mask_encoding: row runs [y,x,length], absolute sheet pixel coordinates
scalpDefinition: Anatomical crown under hair, x=21..39 plus source head dx, y=5..17; opaque face underpainting covers this mask. Ear, cheek, forehead below the hairline are not scalp. Mask must be rechecked when adding another direction or moving the hairline.

production.method: One reference image-edit study, manually traced on the same native 64 px grid. Existing g3 colors only. Fixed option-1 parts and P2 eyes-2/mouth-2 remain byte-identical. No source sprite rescaling.
production.headMotion: Same per-frame head coordinates baked into each layer. Original walking head drifts +1 px x on walk frame 5; y remains fixed. Tail has no secondary motion in this trial.

validation.scope: P3 south only; not full 14-frame acceptance

parts.layout: Rows hair/body/face/eyes/mouth; each option shows isolated part left and composite right; other parts option 1.

walk.format: six-frame strip; no runtime timing proposed

notes: P3 replaces the P2 review images; old previews remain in git history. Runtime option-1 files are unchanged.
Slots 1–7 are unavailable placeholders, not completed directional assets. All-direction scalp/back-face/baseline tests await owner approval.

Hair pair comparison: binary alpha symmetric difference of composited pixels with y<18. Body: binary alpha symmetric difference for y>=32. Face/eyes/mouth: differing composited RGBA pixels. Each comparison holds other parts at option 1.
All existing cape-region RGBA pixels are identical between body options; exposed legs add skin regions.
Eyes/mouth fixed dark outlines and white sclera/teeth are not recolored. Hair outlines retain source dark colors.
